QuestInfo.name: Meaning of Oblivion 2
QuestInfo.0: Record Keeper wants to speak with you. Go see the Record Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: Record Keeper wants you to wander in the the oblivion's dream. Go resist the sweet oblivion in #b#MDmirrorD_328_2_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the #MDmirrorD_328_2_# and finally passed through the past to reach the Road of the Present.

0.0: Your past holds a darkness that even I'm terrified of. Perhaps oblivion would be a blessing for someone with your past. Wouldn't you like to find out?

yes.0: #b#MDmirrorD_328_2_##k is like a waking dream. If you can resist the warm whispers of #r#t4009121##k and #r#t4009122##k, then you should be able to endure anything.

no.0: You can't continue forward if you can't overcome oblivion.

1.0: Master of your memories... Walk the path laid before you.

yes.0: The path you walk will become your past...

default.0: #r#t4009121##k and #r#t4009122##k will continue to tempt you. You must overcome them and continue forward.
